chunks: The first form of jihad with which you will be overpowered is the jihad with your hands,
thereafter with your tongues, and then with your hearts;
Consequently, he who does not recognize virtue with his heart or does not disapprove evil will be turned upside down. Thus, his upside will be turned downwards and his lowside will be turned upwards.
ai.seo_question: What are the three stages of jihad and moral decline described in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this narration from Nahj al-Balagha is often linked to the era of the 'Quietist' Imams, illustrating the gradual erosion of communal authority as active resistance gives way to internal conviction. The concluding metaphor of 'reversal' (qalb) signifies a spiritual inversion where the elite become base and the base become elite, a condition of moral decay that necessitates the guidance of the Imam to restore order.
